svg.aria-label: Mini Dakhl — Exact books, a balance for every currency. Day book, receivables, stock and warehouse, buying and selling, hawala transfers and currency exchange for shops, wholesalers, sarrafs and fuel stations. Offline first, synced across the business's devices.
